docs.text:
Lakshanand Sugumar · Robotics Engineering, ASU Polytechnic · May 2027

  • Robot-Joint Actuator FOC Testbed

    STM32G4 field-oriented control, model-based fault detection, CAN test stack. Nov 2026 – now.

  • Actuator Fault Isolation Paper

    IEEE paper draft: telling encoder faults apart from collisions and payload changes.

  • Siemens S7-1500 Production Cell

    S7-GRAPH sequences, WinCC HMI and an OPC UA OEE dashboard. Nov 2026 – now.

  • ExplainDrive

    An explainable reasoning planner for automated driving, with faithfulness tests. Nov 2026.

  • R6 Recon Amphibot

    EGR 314: three-PCB amphibious scout. Sensor + HMI subsystem lead. Spring 2026.

  • Vision-Guided 3-Axis Pick-and-Place

    EGR 456: PSoC 5LP arm with OpenCV and PID. 92.5% success. Spring 2026.

  • IR Motion-Sensing Door Actuator

    EGR 304: infrared sensing subsystem for a home door opener. Fall 2025.

  • SDCF: A Bus With No Master

    Masterless, fault-tolerant RS-485 TDMA bus for industrial control. Research since 2024.

  • Array Technologies Capstone

    EGR 401/402 Team 20: row detection add-on for solar PV trackers. Co-PM. In progress.

  • Dual-Domain Galvanic Handoff Earbuds

    Simulation-only paper: sub-500 nA standby island and lossless audio path in a 4.2 mm stem.

  • Orange Juice Vending Machine

    Automation showcase designed to IEC 60335. Designing.

  • Zephy

    My self-hosted, Jarvis-style personal assistant. Ninth upgrade.

The EGR 314 subsystem datasheet stays at the root of this domain.
